core_taste_summary: Matt responds most strongly when songs have physical force, pressured hooks, emotional conviction, and a sense that production reveals the artist's essence rather than sanding it down. He likes intelligence, architecture, theater, and polish when they are embodied. He usually rejects music that looks adjacent on genre paper but lacks blood, body, bite, or committed persona.

landmarks.name: Nirvana
landmarks.evidence: Core rupture point. Useful for body force, plainspoken wound, hooks under pressure, source-code noise, and anti-slop calibration.
landmarks.edge_conditions: Nirvana does not imply approval of post-grunge, fake-hard rock, generic grunge cosplay, or sludgy seriousness without song pressure.

landmarks.name: Local H
landmarks.evidence: Working-band identity, compressed guitar pressure, hooks with damage, directness without mush.
landmarks.edge_conditions: Use as evidence for pressure and identity, not as a blanket alt-rock approval signal.

landmarks.name: Beatles / oldies-radio melody foundation
landmarks.evidence: Deep melody grammar, compression, singability, memory warmth, and pop craft.
landmarks.edge_conditions: Melody alone is insufficient when pressure, ache, or identity are absent.

landmarks.name: Radiohead: The Bends / OK Computer
landmarks.evidence: Melodic ache, dread architecture, band identity, emotional force inside studio design.
landmarks.edge_conditions: Does not imply automatic appetite for tasteful art-rock, sleepy prestige, or heady abstraction.

landmarks.name: Weezer: Blue Album / Pinkerton
landmarks.evidence: Hooks under pressure, plain wound, guitar body, self-exposure, melody with ache.
landmarks.edge_conditions: Does not imply broad emo, pop-punk, or ironic geek-rock appetite.

landmarks.name: Toadies: Rubberneck
landmarks.evidence: Hard guitar songs with menace, body, and no fake-hard costume.
landmarks.edge_conditions: Useful as a slop detector for current rock.

landmarks.name: Hum: You'd Prefer an Astronaut
landmarks.evidence: Heavy melodic atmosphere, pressure, scale, and body-first space-rock.
landmarks.edge_conditions: Do not turn this into generic shoegaze, post-rock, or metal appetite.

landmarks.name: Type O Negative
landmarks.evidence: A singular exception where dark melodic atmosphere, commitment, absurdity, theater, and body lock together.
landmarks.edge_conditions: Do not infer broad gothic metal. Treat as one-object exception unless new evidence recurs.

landmarks.name: Muse: Origin of Symmetry / Absolution
landmarks.evidence: Theatricality earned by scale, hooks, body, melodic pressure, and total commitment.
landmarks.edge_conditions: Muse does not imply Tool, A Perfect Circle, generic prog-metal, or over-serious heady heavy music.

landmarks.name: The Decemberists peak-era album-worlds
landmarks.evidence: Literary theatrical world-building works when melody, commitment, and album-world logic are strong.
landmarks.edge_conditions: Does not imply generic indie-folk, soft tasteful folk, or cabaret frame.

landmarks.name: Arcade Fire album-worlds
landmarks.evidence: Communal scale, album-world architecture, emotional conviction, and pressure.
landmarks.edge_conditions: Does not imply general approval of earnest indie or prestige tastefulness.

landmarks.name: Taylor Swift hard persona-pop / pop architecture
landmarks.evidence: The fit is not generic pop. It is architecture, persona, bite, melodic construction, and emotional center.
landmarks.edge_conditions: Avoid generic pop sheen without persona, story pressure, or hard construction.

melody with ache

strong_regions.name: hard persona-pop
strong_regions.negative_boundary: generic pop sheen and prestige softness

promising_frontiers.name: current rock with pulse
promising_frontiers.test_goal: Find modern guitar music that has body, conviction, and identity without fake-hard or scene-posture traps.
promising_frontiers.required_uncertainty: Old rock love is not evidence that current rock works.

promising_frontiers.name: female art-pop with bite
promising_frontiers.test_goal: Separate rupture persona and architecture from tasteful soft prestige pop.
promising_frontiers.required_uncertainty: Do not assume art-pop equals fit.

promising_frontiers.name: Lithuanian artists frontier
promising_frontiers.test_goal: Test cultural/geographic discovery without hallucinating catalog certainty or inflating weak evidence.
promising_frontiers.required_uncertainty: Use resolver placeholders and preserve uncertainty about availability and fit.

promising_frontiers.name: era-personal routes
promising_frontiers.test_goal: Build personal-year maps that compete with generic critic canon.
promising_frontiers.required_uncertainty: Historical importance is not personal fit.

known_dead_ends.name: adult-alt / VH1 sincerity
known_dead_ends.why_it_fails: Sincerity becomes mush when there is no pressure, bite, or specific wound.
known_dead_ends.use_in_missions: Can be tested as a Dead End Check if the learning design is explicit.

known_dead_ends.name: post-grunge slop
known_dead_ends.why_it_fails: Borrows surface heaviness from Nirvana/alt-rock while losing hooks under pressure and artist essence.
known_dead_ends.use_in_missions: Use sparingly as boundary proof, not as filler.

known_dead_ends.name: fake-hard rock
known_dead_ends.why_it_fails: Performs intensity without blood or identity.
known_dead_ends.use_in_missions: Flag as trap in current rock tests.

known_dead_ends.name: generic prog-metal as Muse substitute
known_dead_ends.why_it_fails: Replaces committed melodrama and hooks with heady seriousness.
known_dead_ends.use_in_missions: Avoid Tool/APC-style routes unless used as explicit boundary checks.

known_dead_ends.name: broad emo from Jimmy Eat World
known_dead_ends.why_it_fails: A strong Bleed American response does not license broad emo/pop-punk assumptions.

known_dead_ends.name: generic dance-punk from LCD Soundsystem
known_dead_ends.why_it_fails: This Is Happening does not imply generic dance-punk appetite.
known_dead_ends.use_in_missions: Test architecture, voice, and groove separately.

known_dead_ends.name: generic indie-folk from The Decemberists
known_dead_ends.why_it_fails: Peak album-worlds do not imply soft folk approval.
known_dead_ends.use_in_missions: Require committed world-building and melodic pressure.

known_dead_ends.name: broad gothic metal from Type O Negative
known_dead_ends.why_it_fails: Type O is a singular committed exception.

known_dead_ends.name: prestige/tasteful indie without blood/body
known_dead_ends.why_it_fails: Tastefulness can feel inert if the body and emotional center are missing.
known_dead_ends.use_in_missions: Probe only when a candidate has rupture, bite, or architecture.

known_dead_ends.name: modern rock scene-posture
known_dead_ends.why_it_fails: Signals scene identity more than song pressure or conviction.
known_dead_ends.use_in_missions: Current rock missions should include explicit posture checks.

known_dead_ends.name: generic pop sheen without persona or architecture
known_dead_ends.why_it_fails: Polish alone is not the fit. The fit is construction plus bite/persona.
known_dead_ends.use_in_missions: Taylor-adjacent routes must test architecture and persona.

useful_waypoints.name: QOTSA
useful_waypoints.use: Useful shelf for groove, desert weight, and background energy. Do not promote to core canon without fresh evidence.

useful_waypoints.name: Kyuss
useful_waypoints.use: Desert/heavy context. Helpful shelf, not a confirmed Landmark.

useful_waypoints.name: Thee Oh Sees / Osees
useful_waypoints.use: Garage/psych force shelf. May supply energy and source-code noise but needs recurrence.

useful_waypoints.name: Black Keys
useful_waypoints.use: Some garage revival and family-safe energy. Treat as B/B+ shelf, not core identity.

useful_waypoints.name: cultural furniture / nostalgia tracks
useful_waypoints.use: Known songs can be useful in routes but should not become Atlas evidence automatically.

user_vocabulary: body first, brain at the summit
taste_rules: Body first, brain at the summit.
Production should reveal the artist's essence.
Polish is fine if it has blood, bite, architecture, or emotional center.
Theatricality can work when fully committed.
anti_overfitting_rules: Muse does not imply generic prog-metal or A Perfect Circle / Tool-style seriousness.
Type O Negative does not imply broad gothic metal.
LCD Soundsystem's This Is Happening does not imply generic dance-punk.
The Decemberists do not imply generic indie-folk.
Taylor Swift does not imply generic pop appetite.
Jimmy Eat World's Bleed American does not imply broad emo/pop-punk approval.
QOTSA / Kyuss are useful shelves, not core canon.
Current rock must avoid fake-hard, scene-posture, and post-grunge slop traps.
mission_generation_priorities: Every route item needs a job.
Every item needs an expected positive and negative signal.
Feedback chips must be personalized to user, song, mission, expected signal, and reaction operation.
Use stable primary reaction operations: love, like, keep, not_for_me.
Prefer bounded update candidates over broad Atlas claims.
Use MusicKit search hints and unresolved placeholders; do not hallucinate catalog resolution.
